definitions.explanation: The state of being elderly or at an advanced age. A neutral and respectful term commonly used in official, medical, and social contexts.

examples.english: Please offer this seat to elderly people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高齢|こうれい}にもかかわらず⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Despite her advanced age, my grandmother never misses her morning walk.

notes:
A respectful, neutral term for old age. Preferred over ⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧ in official and polite contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ (elderly person — the standard official term)
- ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧ (aging — of a population)
- ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (aging society)
- {高齢|こうれい}⟦{出産|しゅっさん}→出産：11734_shussan⟧ (childbirth at advanced age)
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ (people aged 75 and over)

In Japan, ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧ officially refers to people aged 65 and older. {高齢|こうれい}{運転者|うんてんしゃ}⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧ (elderly driver mark) is required for drivers aged 70+.
